hooks.command: cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); if printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -Eq 'git push[^|]*(--force|-f\b)|git reset --hard|git branch -D|git push[^|]*--delete|rm -rf +(/|~|\$HOME)/?\*?( |$)|DROP (TABLE|DATABASE)'; then echo 'Blocked: destructive command. Ask a human for explicit confirmation (AGENTS.md, Security).' >&2; exit 2; fi

f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); p="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR%/}"; [ -n "$p" ] && cd "$p" || exit 0; case "$f" in "$p"/*) r="/${f#"$p"/}";; *) exit 0;; esac; case "$r" in */../*|*/..|*/node_modules/*) exit 0;; esac; b=node_modules/.bin/biome; [ -x "$b" ] && "$b" format --write "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1; true

f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); p="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR%/}"; [ -n "$p" ] && cd "$p" || exit 0; case "$f" in "$p"/*) r="/${f#"$p"/}";; *) exit 0;; esac; case "$r" in */../*|*/..|*/node_modules/*) exit 0;; esac; case "${f##*/}" in package.json|package-lock.json|npm-shrinkwrap.json) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; [ -f package-lock.json ] || [ -f npm-shrinkwrap.json ] || exit 0; command -v npm >/dev/null || exit 0; npm audit --audit-level=high >&2 || { echo 'npm audit failed or found issues. Resolve them before continuing.' >&2; exit 2; }; true

cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && { [ -f tasks/todo.md ] && echo '## tasks/todo.md' && cat tasks/todo.md; [ -f tasks/lessons.md ] && echo '## tasks/lessons.md' && cat tasks/lessons.md; git log --oneline -5 2>/dev/null; } ; true

if [ "$(jq -r '.stop_hook_active // false')" = 'true' ]; then exit 0; fi; p="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR%/}"; [ -n "$p" ] && cd "$p" || exit 0; [ -f package.json ] && command -v npm >/dev/null || exit 0; fail() { echo "$1 Fix it before ending the session (AGENTS.md, handoff)." >&2; exit 2; }; t=$(jq -r '.scripts.test // empty' package.json 2>/dev/null) || fail 'package.json does not parse.'; case "$t" in ''|*'no test specified'*) exit 0;; esac; npm test >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail 'The test suite is failing.'; tsc=node_modules/.bin/tsc; if [ -f tsconfig.json ] && [ -x "$tsc" ]; then "$tsc" --noEmit >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail 'The type check is failing.'; fi; true
